catalog.name: entity:discuss.channel
catalog.description: Complete definition of entity Discussion Channel (discuss.channel).

fields.name: active
fields.help: Set active to false to hide the channel without removing it.

fields.name: channel_type
fields.help: Chat is private and unique between 2 persons. Group is private among invited persons. Channel can be freely joined (depending on its configuration).

fields.name: default_display_mode
fields.help: Determines how the channel will be displayed by default when opening it from its invitation link. No value means display text (no voice/video).

fields.name: from_message_id
fields.help: The message the channel was created from.

fields.name: last_interest_dt
fields.help: Contains the date and time of the last interesting event that happened in this channel. This updates itself when new message posted.

fields.name: group_ids
fields.help: Members of those groups will automatically added as followers. Note that they will be able to manage their subscription manually if necessary.

fields.name: channel_name_member_ids
fields.help: Members from which the channel name is computed when the name field is empty.

fields.name: duration
fields.help: Duration of the session in hours

fields.name: livechat_lang_id
fields.help: Lang of the visitor of the channel.

fields.name: livechat_end_dt
fields.help: Session is closed when either the visitor or the last agent leaves the conversation.

fields.name: livechat_note
fields.help: Note about the session, visible to all internal users having access to the session.

fields.name: country_id
fields.help: Country of the visitor of the channel

fields.name: lead_ids
fields.help: The channel becomes accessible to sales users when leads are set.

fields.name: subscription_department_ids
fields.help: Automatically subscribe members of those departments to the channel.

fields.name: is_pending_chat_request
fields.string: When created from an operator, whether the channel is yet to be opened on the visitor side.
fields.full_name: When created from an operator, whether the channel is yet to be opened on the visitor side.

constraints.name: _from_message_id_unique
constraints.message: Messages can only be linked to one sub-channel

constraints.name: _uuid_unique
constraints.message: The channel UUID must be unique

constraints.name: _group_public_id_check
constraints.message: Group authorization and group auto-subscription are only supported on channels.

constraints.name: _livechat_operator_id
constraints.definition: CHECK((channel_type = 'livechat' and livechat_operator_id is not null) or (channel_type != 'livechat'))
constraints.message: Livechat Operator ID is required for a channel of type livechat.

constraints.name: _livechat_end_dt_status_constraint
constraints.definition: CHECK(livechat_end_dt IS NULL or livechat_status IS NULL)
constraints.message: Closed Live Chat session should not have a status.

Join a live chat for which help was requested.

:returns: Whether the live chat was joined. False if the live chat could not
    be joined because another agent already joined the channel in the meantime.
:rtype: bool

Add a human operator to the conversation. The conversation with the chatbot (scripted chatbot or ai agent) is stopped
the visitor will continue the conversation with a real person.

In case we don't find any operator (e.g: no-one is available) we don't post any messages.
The chat with the chatbot will continue normally, which allows to add extra steps when it's the case
(e.g: ask for the visitor's email and create a lead).

:param chatbot_script_step: the forward to operator chatbot script step if the forwarding is done through
a scripted chatbot (not used if the forwarding is done through an AI Agent).
:param users: recordset of candidate operators, if not provided the currently available
    users of the livechat channel are used as candidates instead.

When website is installed, we can link the created lead from /lead command
to the current website_visitor. We do not use the lead name as it does not correspond
to the lead contact name.
